thread:
lina_research: kicking off a short thread — bringing up a 2-stage speculative pipeline for horizon-optimized models. want to capture bring-up notes + quick eval plan.

sara_ml: nice. is this the 'prefetch+kz' two-stage we sketched last week? :eyes:

lina_research: yeah similar idea but with an explicit horizon cutoff and separate quantized short-path. stage1 = cheap prefetch (quant 4-bit, small kv), stage2 = full float fallback. goal: 2-3x p50 token throughput without regressing instr-follow.

ben_platform: curious about routing logic — how do we pick candidates for stage2? fixed top-k? threshold on logits?

lina_research: plan is lightweight scoring on stage1 logits: if highest-next-token prob < 0.2 or entropy > 5.5 then promote to stage2. also force-promote for safety prompts (we'll tag via prompt classifier).

mike_infra: any infra constraints? memory for duplicate kvs? we need to estimate extra GPU mem for caching both paths concurrently.

lina_research: good call — rough numbers: for 70B quant4 stage1 KV ~ 45% of full kv size; keeping both cached increases peak by ~30% on our current allocation. Sara can run a memory microbenchmark.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline/feature/horizon-speculative started — build 2026.03.20-17:12:01.

ben_platform: do we have an eval harness for quality regression beyond next-token perplexity? last time PPL hid degenerate safety failures.

eva_qc: propose three-tier eval: 1) automated instr-follow synthetic (50k prompts), 2) targeted safety & hallucination probes (~2k high-risk), 3) small-scale human eval on 500 examples comparing stage1-only vs full-route. metrics: instruction accuracy, hallucination rate, edit-distance on code tasks, and scorer-based MAUVE/BERTR/ROUGE where appropriate.

sara_ml: + include throughput/latency distribution: p50/p90/p99 token latency, tokens/sec for batch sizes 1/4/16. Also measure token-efficiency (tokens generated per GPU-second).

lina_research: experiment plan: run with llama-like 34b and horizon-optimized 70b hybrid. quantize stage1 with q4_0 and q4_1, try int8 perf kernel on stage2 fallback for cost comps.

mike_infra: please add a canary in prod config: route 1% traffic to speculative for specific internal orgs only, plus slow-fallback tracing enabled. we need KV cache consistency logs.

ben_platform: how do we avoid feedback loops where stage1 generates tokens that keep stage2 busy and nullify gains?

lina_research: add a "prefetch budget" heuristic: max prefetch tokens per request = 64 and early-stop if stage1 latency > 30ms. also dynamic backoff if stage2 queue spikes above threshold.

eva_qc: on eval stats: check per-prompt deltas and run paired bootstrap for significance. set acceptance threshold: no more than 0.5% absolute drop on instr-acc and <1% increase in hallucination with 95% conf.

sara_ml: quick check: can we simulate a few failure modes locally? like adversarially long conditional prompts forcing stage1 mispredicts. I'll craft 200 stress prompts.

ci-bot: perf-tests/speculative-horizon completed — artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/speculative-horizon/2065432100/run-1 .

mike_infra: artifact noted. I'll spin a perf instance and run memory + p99 traces. expect logs in /var/log/speculative-horizon.

lina_research: outstanding items: (1) bench memory and p50/p99 across batches (sara + mike), (2) run eval harness + paired bootstrap (eva + sara), (3) infra canary config + KV tracing (ben + mike), (4) human eval prep + prompt selection (eva).

ben_platform: assigning tasks in the doc. I'll create a canary runbook after bench numbers. :thumbsup:

sara_ml: will start stress prompt set now and post initial perf numbers by EOD.

lina_research: thanks all — we'll reconvene tomorrow 10:30 to review numbers. TL;DR: two-stage speculative with horizon cutoff, prefetch budget, paired-eval acceptance criteria. :rocket:
